caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wooden chest of drawers with four drawers, each featuring decorative motifs. The chest is primarily painted in two colors: a reddish-brown for the drawer fronts and panel insets, and a dark green for the structural framing, edges, and borders. Each drawer has two round brass or gold-colored knobs, symmetrically placed. The topmost drawer is the shortest and includes a central design featuring two green birds facing a flower or treelike motif. The second drawer from the top is slightly taller and displays a similar, yet larger, motif with two birds facing each other around a central heart-shaped element. The third drawer down repeats the bird motif, while the lowest drawer features two mirrored figures in yellow and green garments, each holding up an object in one hand. Small, simple line details in black outline each drawer and corner of the chest, and stylized green foliage or feather shapes fill the corners. The chest stands on four short, turned feet in brown. The background is plain and uncolored, with the artist's name, "FRANCES LICHTEN," inscribed at the lower right.
title: Chest of Drawers
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
